user.title: Configure Intelligent Heating Pilot
user.description: Set up your Intelligent Heating Pilot (IHP) integration for intelligent preheating calculations based on learned thermal slopes from your VTherm.

data.name: Integration Name
data.humidity_out_entity_id: Outdoor Humidity Sensor or Weather Entity (optional)
data.temperature_out_entity_id: Outdoor Temperature Sensor or Weather Entity (optional)
data.cloud_cover_entity_id: Cloud Coverage Sensor or Weather Entity (optional)

data_description.name: A friendly name for this IHP device, e.g. the room it heats.
data_description.vtherm_entity_id: The Versatile Thermostat whose heating IHP learns and anticipates.
data_description.scheduler_entities: HACS Scheduler switches that control this VTherm. A native schedule helper only gets an anticipated start time: IHP does not start the heating for it.
data_description.humidity_in_entity_id: Room humidity sensor to refine calculations.
data_description.humidity_out_entity_id: Outdoor humidity sensor or weather entity. Monitored, not used in the prediction yet.
data_description.temperature_out_entity_id: Outdoor temperature sensor or weather entity, recorded with each heating cycle.
data_description.cloud_cover_entity_id: Cloud coverage sensor or weather entity to account for solar impact.
data_description.lhs_retention_days: Number of days to retain slope data in storage. Default: 30 days.
data_description.dead_time_minutes: Delay between the start of heating and the first temperature rise. Used until IHP has learned it from heating cycles, and always when automatic learning is off. Default: 0 min.
data_description.auto_learning: Learn the dead time from heating cycles. When off, the initial dead time is always used. The heating slope is learned in both cases.
data_description.temp_delta_threshold: Temperature difference used to detect the start and end of a heating cycle. Lower values make the detection more sensitive. Default: 0.2°C.
data_description.cycle_split_duration_minutes: Split long heating cycles into sub-cycles of this duration for ML training augmentation. 0 = disabled (default).
data_description.min_cycle_duration_minutes: Shortest heating cycle kept for learning. Filters out micro-cycles (noise). Default: 5 min.
data_description.max_cycle_duration_minutes: Longest heating cycle kept for learning. Filters out abnormally long cycles (malfunctions). Default: 300 min.
data_description.task_range_days: Number of days per Recorder extraction task. Increase on powerful machines to reduce task count. Decrease on slow machines to reduce query load per task. Default: 7 days.
data_description.anticipation_recalc_tolerance_minutes: Minimum postponement of the anticipated start that cancels an active preheating and reschedules it. Default: 15 min.
data_description.safety_shutoff_grace_minutes: Grace period for brief heating interruptions (safety/frost mode). Interruptions shorter than this do not end the cycle in progress. 0 = disabled. Default: 10 min.

calculate_anticipated_start_time.name: Calculate Anticipated Start Time from IHP Device
calculate_anticipated_start_time.description: Calculate the optimal start time for a configured IHP device to reach target temperature at the specified time. Uses the device's learned heating slope and current environmental data.

entity_id.name: IHP Entity ID
entity_id.description: The entity ID of the IHP device (e.g., sensor.intelligent_heating_pilot_anticipated_start_time)

target_time.name: Target Time
target_time.description: Time when the target temperature should be reached

target_temp.name: Target Temperature
target_temp.description: Desired target temperature in Celsius (optional, uses VTherm target if not specified)

reset_learning.name: Reset Learning History
reset_learning.description: Clear the learned heating slopes and dead time of an IHP device, then relearn them from the Recorder history

entity_id.name: IHP Entity ID
entity_id.description: The entity ID of the IHP device whose learning data should be reset (e.g., sensor.intelligent_heating_pilot_anticipated_start_time)
